applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Responsible Business Conduct) Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: NBFCs may optionally provide relief measures such as fee waivers for customers in calamity-declared areas.
answer.action_quote: A NBFC at its discretion, may provide relief measures such as waiver / reduction of various fees and charges in respect of customers in the areas where a calamity has been declared

effective_date.quote: The above amendment shall come into force with effect from July 1, 2026.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions
